terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before accessing the Pharmacy Education Platform.
terms.sec1Body: By creating an account, beginning a free trial, or purchasing a subscription, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not access or use our services.
terms.sec2Body: The platform provides simulated educational modules, pharmacokinetic models, and medicinal chemistry visualizations designed for pharmacy students. It is strictly an educational tool and does not constitute medical advice or clinical guidelines.
terms.sec3Body: Lessons 1 and 2 of every curriculum module remain permanently accessible without charge. Eligible users may activate a single 7-day cardless free trial. Accounts revert to free status with 100% progress preserved upon expiration.
terms.sec4Body: Payment processing, invoicing, and tax collection are handled by Dodo Payments Inc. as Merchant of Record. By subscribing, you authorize charges according to your chosen billing cycle.
terms.sec5Body: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle unless cancelled prior to renewal. You may cancel anytime via the Customer Portal, effective at period end.
terms.sec6Body: In compliance with Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK No. 6698) and EU GDPR, users may permanently delete accounts at any time, cancelling subscriptions and purging personal records.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.subtitle: Compliance Notice under Turkish Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.sec1Body: Pharmacy Education Platform operates as the Data Controller under Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), committed to safeguarding student data and fundamental privacy rights.
privacy.sec2Body: Identity and contact details (name, email, university, locale), learning progress (completed lessons, scores, Leitner memory states), and entitlement tiers. We never store credit card numbers on our servers; transactions are processed by Dodo Payments.
privacy.sec3Body: We partner with verified sub-processors adhering to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards: Supabase and Cloudflare (hosting, encrypted database, auth) and Dodo Payments Inc. (payment processing, tax compliance).
privacy.sec4Body: Students hold the right to access data processing info, correct inaccuracies, request permanent destruction of personal data, and execute self-service account deletion directly from the platform interface.
privacy.sec5Body: When account deletion is triggered, our backend cancels active recurring subscriptions via Dodo Payments and permanently purges user profile, progress history, and entitlement records.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: Transparent, student-friendly refund terms powered by Dodo Payments.
refund.sec1Body: We want you to feel confident in your pharmacy studies. If you purchase any subscription and are not completely satisfied, you are entitled to a 100% full refund within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked.
refund.sec2Body: Our 7-day free trial requires no credit card upfront. You cannot be charged accidentally upon trial expiration. Billing only occurs if you explicitly choose to subscribe.
refund.sec3Body: You may request a refund either via self-service through your Dodo Payments Customer Portal link or by contacting our support team with your account email and transaction ID.
refund.sec4Body: Once approved, refunds are processed immediately by Dodo Payments Inc. and returned directly to your original payment method, appearing on your statement within 5 to 10 business days.
refund.sec5Title: 5. Effect on Account Access & Learning Progress
refund.sec5Body: When a refund is completed, your account returns to the Free plan. 100% of your completed lessons, quiz scores, and Leitner flashcards remain permanently preserved.
